reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: HX610 (Hong Kong Airlines) was not good. I won't say its terrible but it was not meeting my standard. There was no enterainment system, only a bread and a drink, seat was ok, and surpisingly the cabin was very clean. As you know, Hong Kong Airrlines is budget airline, so I didn't expect too much.
reviews.author: Alyas Yeung

reviews.title: They canceled 4 flights in 2 weeks
reviews.text: They canceled 4 flights in two weeks: Hanoi - Hong Kong 05/21/2023 Hong Kong - Hanoi 05/24/2023 Hanoi - Hong Kong 03/06/2023 Hong Kong - Hanoi 07/06/2023 Nothing to add... 8 weeks to get the money back.
reviews.author: Carmine

reviews.title: Wrong date, wrong price. Broken website.
reviews.text: Their website misrepresents time and cost of tickets. When you pick a date, it will auto adjust to the day before. Then when you contact them to correct the date, they charge roughly 100 USD to change it. Also, the website lists the cost in Hong Kong dollars. When you use USD, they will charge an extra 12% without telling you until you get the confirmation email. This isn't reasonable considering that internation transfer rate is 1 to 3%. They don't respond to emails. And they won't agree to make up for losses their website caused. Please do yourself a favor and don't use this airline. If you do, keep in mind what the website shows you, is not what you will get.
reviews.author: H C

reviews.title: Comfort in Exit row and on time
reviews.text: This is an airbus A-320, single aisle 3X3 seating. On this flight we paid extra for an exit row (rows 42 and 43) This was the best convenience you can have as the seats pitch is extremely tight. The width is ok, but if you do not want your knees pressing against the seat in front of you, take an exit row. The flight was on time leaving and arriving. On board service was adequate for the 2 hour 30 min. flight. The sandwich served was not edible. The plane was elderly but clean and efficient. No AV system or monitors..
reviews.author: bob2bkk

reviews.title: Worst airline amd Rude Ground Staff
reviews.text: Worst airline and Rude Ground Staff No flight Entertainment !!! long flight 6 Hrs. only 1 Bun it test Terrible can not add more beer only 2 Cans. Full Service How?
reviews.author: Niidaz K

reviews.title: 3-hour delay and missed all connecting flights
reviews.text: Horrible. Irresponsible. My time is valuable. Lost 24 hours of work. Around 35 of us got left behind, not 1 or 2, 35+. Ground staff gave a lot of attitude to folks they left behind in Hong Kong. 0 stars.
reviews.author: Raksak K

reviews.title: Male Ground staff at section K biz class counter from 630am to 830am for Hong Kong airline
reviews.text: Writing this review on my flight. I should have asked for his name but all this happened too fast. My travel agent in Singapore CTM should have well informed me of the PCR requirement from Hong Kong to Shanghai. This gentlemen at the counter patiently explained the requirement to me as it hit me by utter surprise at 630am in the morning. He brought me to the PcR test counter in person and helped to request for a! Accelerated case, thought without success. Most importantly, the pcr test came in right at the last minute about 35 min before the flight. As I ran towards the counter, I could see the gentlemen all ready stand by waiting for me to help me squeeze the last check in. 200% applaud for his professionalism. He was wearing a mask and spec, and a well mannered genteman. Thank you thank you very much. Best regards Jie Hong
reviews.author: LJH

reviews.title: Worst airline experience, their system is a f joke
reviews.text: TLDR: You can always trust a sketchy website = bad fly experience, IF I can still fly today!!! I booked business class from Sapporo, Japan to Hongkong, the Hongkong airline was like 50pounds cheaper than the Cathay flight, worst decision of the year hahaha. The reservation system is like a homework project from a high school kid in the first place, there’re a few languages, but only one of them will actually take you to your destination. If you don’t speak that language, you’d have to google translate. Ha! At this time I already felt like it was too sketchy like a scam website. Guess what? I was right! Then their payment system is wayyy broken, after my bank notified me of the payment, the website showed “403 forbidden”. Lmao. I received the e ticket 5min later, ok. Oh also somehow the English version of online check in doesn’t work, you’ll have to Google translate your way if you don’t know mandarin, haha again! I broke my ribs during the journey, so I had to contact them to arrange special assistance. Their online chat system said I was 2578th in the line! I then tried to call them, took me 30min waiting, and remember I’m flying business class! No dedicated line for premium guests obviously. (They don’t even have a number on their website) Then at the airport checkin counter, they apparently don’t have local staff, so their staff was all borrowed from ANA. They didn’t show up until 2 h before the scheduled departure. Then when they showed up finally, they discovered that th
reviews.author: YC29

reviews.title: Very bad service
reviews.text: We missed the flight to destination and wanted to take the return flight from same ticket back to origin. Airport Check in counter said they don’t have the equipment to help letting us use the return flight, so we wanted to ask for customer service help since the online system cannot work with this special case. But the customer service is impossible to reach, the chatbot queue is over 3 hundred. It’s not possible to get any help for make things work. Feel like one you buy a ticket there won’t be post purchase service, they are taking your money anyway.
reviews.author: Karen C

reviews.title: No vegetarian option
reviews.text: They had one option for food, pork. Vegetarians don't exist? Religions who don't eat pork don't matter? I'm not surprised this airline has such poor ratings.
reviews.author: Tom M

reviews.title: Terrible Service
reviews.text: My flight which was from Hong Kong to Shanghai was cancelled within 12 hours of notice, without any warnings whatsoever. All they did was sent a half of SMS. When I tried to ask the customer service for details, they would not respond by email or on the phone, I had to call the airport authority for details about entry regulations into China. The cancellation came with no reimbursement whatsoever, and after a whole day, they finally responded to my emails. Thank god I can now be paying for another 2 nights of hotel rather than having sit in the cramped plane. Furthermore, you cannot trust them with the money, the refund process will take an entire 6-8 weeks?? You cannot trust them with the flight schedule, they can outright cancel your flight at any time they want and they won't even look at you. You cannot trust them with your ticket, when I logged into my account, I couldn't find any flights. If I hadn't taken any screenshots of the Ticket Number, I wouldn't even know I actually booked the flight using this airline. Please for love of god, choose another airline because other airlines actually have decent service. Even Eastern Airlines have better service. Its a pure comedy this airline has "Hong Kong" in it, since it runs just like its counterpart.
reviews.author: Kevin Wong

reviews.title: Flight Cancelled , not informed..
reviews.text: Awful Airline, I had booked a flight from London to Manila on MyTrip, first leg was on Virgin to Hong Kong, second leg was HK Air to Manila, it was on the same booking code. Two weeks before flight HK Air changed their flight to a much later one, they did send a half English/Chinese message and MyTrip updated me as well. That was bad enough, Then on the Night before my flight I looked on the HK Airlines Website and Found My Flight had been Cancelled. Called MyTrip who confirmed flight cancelled, no alternative but to request a Refund which was done, but I have to say I will never book a flight that goes on Hong Kong Airlines Again.. Awful Experience, ruined our Plans to spend Christmas in the Philippines, money down the drain on Covid Tests etc.. it is to near Christmas to find another flight. Disgusted..
reviews.author: WilliamAbdn

reviews.title: Terrible from beginning to end
reviews.text: Everything was terrible. The check in crew were rude and the whole trip just stayed the same. I tried to be nice and friendly but everyone was still rude. They only served little cups of water. Try and ask for more, good luck. I was receiving wheelchair assistance at the airport and they told me to wait for them and forgot me. Then when someone came they literally took me and dumped me at my next flight location. No wheelchair, no asking if I need to stop anywhere or needed anything. They took me to a chair dumped me and took off with the wheelchair. It was the worst experience ever. I will never fly with them again.
reviews.author: Christine S

reviews.title: the cheating airline officers atHong kong airport
reviews.text: I am Egyptian married to Filipino. I had valid visa from the embassy of the Philippines in Riyadh and letter from the embassy permitting me to enter Philippines. I have all the docs including, PCR, fully vaccinated certificate, return ticket, marriage certificate, passport with 8 pervious visas to the Philippines. Hong Kong airlines checked my docs from 5 pm until 1 am and they informed me it is OK to fly. one minute before boarding they prevented me from from boarding and requested DFA letter. I explained to them that the letter I have is the only letter provided by the Embassy. They make me miss the flight, and I waited in the airport until morning. In the morning, Emirates liaised with PAL airlines and requested me to pay my own ticket to PAL, which I did and I paid 3161 Hong Kong Dollars. Hong Kong airlines was strict for nothing and they employ cheating and stupid people to assess the docs. they cheated me and advised that my papers are ok, then they requested me not to board the plane one minute before boarding.
reviews.author: mohamed e

reviews.title: A memorable flight
reviews.text: During the outbreak of coronavirus I got stuck in HK for 7 weeks for not able to return my workplace in mainland China, my original flight from Haikou to ChangSha was cancelled due to situation in China, then situation was getting stable, finally I got the flight on the 14th. The HK airport was empty which I never seen before, 7 staffs in custom check point serving two of us was quite friendly & helpful. The flight was smooth, the air hostesses are friendly & efficient, no unnecessary cleaning moves during the flight. We went through temperature check and been asked few questions by Chinese custom after landed in Haikou. Finally we got our luggage and ready for the transit. Unfortunately we been told there were 4 Passengers in the same flight been checked with fever so all the passengers in this flight have to stay in Haikou for a 14-days isolation of medical observation, I m wondering how these 4 passengers were able to got on the aircraft with high temperature in HK? I had my birthday celebration in my hotel room with no expectation to be ended up to spent 14 days in Haikou, wonderful.
reviews.author: Jeff W Cheng

reviews.title: Rude Flight Attendants not friendly
reviews.text: My wife & I flew Hong Kong Airlines from Bali back to Hong Kong. The ground staff was friendly but the Flight Attendants were unfriendly. My wife & I our Flight Attendants at two U.S. Major Airlines. For a 5 hour flight they only did one service. When I got my beverage the cup was only half filled. I will try to avoid Hong Kong Airlines in the future for travel. Going to Bali we flew Cathay Pacific they were excellent.
reviews.author: travelermanPhoenix

reviews.title: Enjoyable long flight
reviews.text: The gate staff is very helpful and accommodating. That makes a difference on long flights as they made adjustments on our seats and gave us passport advice. Nice seats help too.
reviews.author: Bill B

reviews.title: Feel cheated: No refund of money after waiting for 3 months
reviews.text: This flight was cancelled by Hong kong airlines. I booked the flight via Travelgenia online portal. I was being told by travelgenia customer care on 30th Nov 2019 that I would get my refund within 3 months but unfortunately until today I couldn't get my refund.
reviews.author: Ashok S

reviews.title: My United & China Air flights were canceled, but HK Air required I still make the trip to Asia anyhow
reviews.text: I contacted HK Air after my US to Taiwan and HK flights were canceled by both carriers. I asked for a refund since it was not possible for me to take my side trip to Naha, Okinawa since I was no longer traveling to Hong Kong. I sent an email and explained our dilemma and the customer rep and manager only kept quoting policy. They were professional but seemed stringent on quoting that I had to be traveling from Mainland China for them to provide a refund. I must say the manager was willing to waive a reticketing fee for us, but the funds were only good until June 2020. The likelihood of us using the funds is remote. I had hope HK Air understood my dilemma and would exercise reasonable business practices instead I must eat the ticket and fees. In the future, I shall avoid this airline in the future. Please do not waste your time and book with China Airlines instead.
reviews.author: The Humble Traveler

reviews.title: An ok flight
reviews.text: We flew with Hong Kong air in January. The flight was fine, attendants were fine but felt that the service was a bit slow. The food on our way to Bangkok was terrible. I had a beef dish that was almost all fat. The salad was inedible and the rest of it just ok. Both flights to Bangkok and back to Vancouver had no in flight movies that were working and for a 14 hour flight, it made it very long.
reviews.author: Gail S

reviews.title: Delayed and unsafe baggage handling
reviews.text: This is an indelible experience from a first time flyer of Hong Kong Airlines; it was 10 days after i received my baggage. From Pudong Airport i flew via connecting flight to Hong Kong then to Manila. Checked in our baggage in Pudong airport but when i reached my final destination; Manila, my vacation became a nightmare after i knew that my baggage was left by the airline at Hong Kong. Uneasy thinking that all my essentials where on it. After three days i received a call where they told me that my baggage will be delivered on that day, i thought the nightmare will be over but when i saw the luggage it was not mine. Imagine!!! they are not aware that luggage that they were giving me was not mine so i disowned the luggage. The nightmare continues, calling and emailing the customer service but it’s like i’m talking to a ghost no updates and no replies. I also sent a photo of my luggage for their reference and for them to easily compare it. After 10days of waiting, finally it arrived and when i checked my belongings, one item was missing. It was a Puma cap that i would give for my brother. I don’t know what kind of service does Hong Kong Airlines is serving, but i know this would be my last fly using Hong Kong Airlines because of delayed and unsafe baggage handling.
reviews.author: Chrissie A

reviews.title: Extremely bad customer service at boarding gate and lack of a brain from the captain.
reviews.text: Extremely bad customer service from Hong Kong airlines. The captain on this flight is lacking a brain. Boarding gate agents wouldn't help. What a headache dealing with their staff. Captain wanted to close the gate at 840pm when the flight leaves at 9pm. Never again will I fly with this airline and I encourage everyone not to fly with them. What a joke they are. They simply don't care. This airline is a straight cash grab. They wouldn't refund my return portion of the flight either.
reviews.author: Ken

reviews.title: Overall Inconsistent and Poor Customer Service
reviews.text: The service for this airline is terrible. I had called ahead to ask if I could check an item in my bag, and received a positive response on the phone, then was told at the desk I wasn't allowed to. I filed a formal complaint both on the phone and by e-mail, never received a response. The desk staff are rude, and when I asked for their names, they practically yelled at me that I'm not allowed to know their names and how dare I complain. Worst service.
reviews.author: Octopods

reviews.title: Comfortable with personable staff.
reviews.text: This is an Airbus A330. Wide body, 2-3-2 seating. This is a lot more comfortable than the A320. Legroom is very good and width is snug but ok. There is a seat back monitor but no AV system. No headsets. A box lunch was served for the late afternoon flight. Service is very good and plane is clean and there are more restrooms. Flight left Hong Kong late and arrived late.
reviews.author: bob2bkk

reviews.title: A320 is tight, but the airline offers good service.
reviews.text: This is an AIrbus A320. SIngle aisle 3 X 3 seats. The service on Hong Kong Airlines is very good and the operation is efficient. This aircraft is very basic. The seating is very tight. The pitch is short as my knees were touching the seat in front of me. The width is snug but ok. Remove all the mags and crap in the seat pocket, throw in overhead bin for a bit more knee space. There is no AV system, no monitors or headsets. Monitors drop down for instruction video and then raised. Surprisingly and as I have experienced on other HK Airlines flights, a hot breakfast meal was served. All in all for the 2 hour 20 minute flight it is tolerable but any longer and it would be uncomfortable to be in this aircraft.
reviews.author: bob2bkk

reviews.title: No working monitor for 14 hrs flight
reviews.text: Terrible. No working monitor for the whole 14 hrs flight. what do you expect your customers to do during the flight? you can't even sleep because the leg room is uncomfortable. the food served is not that good as well
reviews.author: Mai M

reviews.title: very reasonable and good service
reviews.text: got a business class ticket for 2100. great service and lounges! Plane is modern and seat configuration is good.
reviews.author: Guido J

reviews.title: Boring flight
reviews.text: There was no entertaining programon the whole flight, no music, no movie, for a 12 hours flight was totally unacceptable. I would never had booked this flight if I knew there is noentertaining program on the flight!
reviews.author: Ricky W

reviews.title: kind service
reviews.text: I feel that they took care of the costumers and the aircraft inside was absolute wonderful, the food, It was good and the access fast.
reviews.author: Josefer M

reviews.title: Wont recommend HK AIRLINES
reviews.text: We rode HK airlines thinking that it will be a good flight but no. I’ll start off with the food, we were served 2 hours after the flight and 2 hours before we land, take note the flight was 14 HOURS LONG. We asked for some snacks for my little sister(she’s 8 years old) BUT YOU YOURSELF HAVE TO GRAB IT from the back, my mom was in shock. Halfway of our flight, most of the passengers are standing up to grab their food. I went at the back to grab some water, i overheard one passenger complaining About whatever is happening and their answer Was there were only FOUR of them working and she’s going back and forth to assist everyone. Second, the TV was only for display. we were expecting that there will be some movies BUT NO. Third, the stewards aren’t really that approachable. whenever we ask questions, its like they’re annoyed.
reviews.author: Marina
